Rooms.Name: Test Room - Starting Point
Rooms.Description:
This is a simple test room. There is a door to the north.
You can use this room to test door commands: open, close, lock, unlock, bash.

Try:
  #Ylook#N          - See the exits (closed doors are hidden)
  #Yopen north#N     - Open the north door
  #Yclose north#N    - Close the north door
  #Ylock north#N     - Lock the north door (requires key 99901)
  #Yunlock north#N   - Unlock the north door (requires key 99901)
  #Ybash north#N     - Bash the door open (requires shield equipped)
  #Ygoto 99901#N     - Teleport to get the key
  #Ygoto 99903#N     - Teleport to get the shield

Rooms.Name: Test Room - Key Storage
Rooms.Description:
This room contains the test key. Pick it up to test locking/unlocking.

Commands:
  #Yget key#N        - Pick up the key
  #Ygoto 99900#N     - Go back to the test room

Rooms.Name: Test Room - Behind the Door
Rooms.Description:
You successfully opened the door! This room is behind the locked door.

The door leads back south. There is a sturdy iron door to the east.

Exits.Description: The wooden door you came through.
A reinforced iron door that looks impossible to break.

Rooms.Name: Test Room - Bash Test Area
Rooms.Description:
This room is for testing the bash command.
There is a test shield on the ground and a bashable door to the west.

Try:
  #Yget shield#N     - Pick up the test shield
  #Ywear shield#N    - Equip the shield
  #Ygoto 99900#N     - Go to starting room
  #Ybash north#N     - Try to bash the wooden door

Objects.Name: key test wooden
Objects.LongDescription: A simple wooden key lies here.
Objects.Description: This is a test key for the test zone door. Use it to lock/unlock the north door in room 99900.

Objects.Name: shield test wooden
Objects.LongDescription: A simple wooden shield lies on the ground.
Objects.Description: This is a test shield. Equip it to test the bash command.
